Two distinct things found and fixed: (1) CRITICAL auth bug - apiClient.js's getBestAccessToken() only ever read AsyncStorage's 'auth_data' key (authService's own email/password token store). This is the real 'not reading the account properly' bug. Fixed by adding a Supabase-session fallback in getBestAccessToken(). (2) Saved searches didn't exist on mobile at all (confirmed via grep - zero hits vs multiple web files). Backend already has full CRUD (GET/POST/DELETE /api/user/saved-searches, confirmed live via curl).
